figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Anti-inflammatory activity of 1 in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells. (A) Cell viability of 1 at 0−160 μM. (B−D) Real-time quantitative
PCR (qPCR) analysis of the mRNA levels of IL-6, TNF-α, and IL-1β in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells. All results are presented as the mean ±
SEM. P values were calculated by one-way ANOVA. ****P < 0.0001, compared with LPS treated cells.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 6. Inhibitory activity of 1 on TGF-β1-induced MRC-5 pulmonary fibrosis. (A) Cell viability of 1 at 0−160 μM. (B−D) Real-time qPCR
analysis of the mRNA levels of FN1, COL1, and α-SMA in TGF-β1-stimulated MRC-5 cells. (E−H) Western blotting analysis for the protein
expression levels (relative to GAPDH) in the MRC-5 cell activated by TGF-β1 (10 ng/mL) and 1 (20, 10, and 5 μM) for 48 h. (I)
Immunofluorescence analysis of protein expression in the MRC-5 cell activated TGF-β1 (10 ng/mL) and 1 (20 μM) for 48 h. Representative
staining images of DAPI (blue), α-SMA (green), and COL1 (red) were obtained under immunofluorescence microscopy (scale bar = 50 μm). All
results are presented as the mean ± SEM. P values were calculated by one-way ANOVA. *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001, and ****P < 0.0001,
compared with TGF-β1 treated cells.
